## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one purpose and is small enough to review.
- [ ] The tests of the parts I changed pass, and `tests/static.sh` passes.
- [ ] If I changed `gateway/Gateway.sol` or `demo/TKA.sol`, I rebuilt the checked-in bytecode.
- [ ] No keys, tokens or passwords are in the change.
- [ ] If this starts reth, it goes through `network/reth/launch.sh`.
- [ ] Each commit has a `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`), by which I certify the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/).
